SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EMP WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND EMP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT EMP_ID AS userId , EMP_NM AS userNm , DEPT_NM AS deptNm , JOB_ROLE AS jobRole , POSITION_NM AS positionNm , CAREER_YEARS AS careerYears , JOB_FIELD AS jobField , DATE_FORMAT(JOIN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS joinDt , IN_OFFICE AS useYn , SKILL_DESC AS skillDesc , ATCH_FILE_ID AS atchFileId , (SELECT FLOOR(IFNULL(SUM(SUB.INPUT_RATE), 0) * 100) FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT SUB WHERE SUB.EMP_ID = TB_EMP.EMP_ID AND SUB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN SUB.START_DT AND SUB.END_DT /*AND SUB.END_DT >= CURDATE()*/ ) AS currentLoad
FROM TB_EMP WHERE EMP_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT PROJ_ID as projId , EMP_ID as userId , DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , INPUT_RATE as inputRate FROM TB_ASSIGNMENT WHERE EMP_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND CONFIRM_YN != 'Y'
